Brines House finish study — locally bundled texture sources
Downloaded November 1, 2026. The Poly Haven sources below are licensed CC0:
https://polyhaven.com/license

wood_floor — Dimitrios Savva
https://polyhaven.com/a/wood_floor
2K diffuse, OpenGL normal, roughness. Source repeat: 1.7 m, nine boards.
The app exposes board width and direction; pale/smoked colors are illustrative tints.

oak_veneer_01 — Jenelle van Heerden
https://polyhaven.com/a/oak_veneer_01
2K diffuse, OpenGL normal, roughness. Source repeat: 1.8 m.
Walnut option is a color study on this oak grain, not scanned walnut.

marble_01 — Rob Tuytel
https://polyhaven.com/a/marble_01
1K diffuse. A joint-free portion is sampled at runtime to add stone variation.
Tile joints, formats, base colors and surface relief are generated by the app.

beige_wall_001 — Dimitrios Savva / Rico Cilliers
https://polyhaven.com/a/beige_wall_001
1K OpenGL normal. Source repeat: 3 m. Paint color supplied independently.

Materials are representative studies, not manufacturer textures or calibrated
product matches. Tile formats, grain, stain, paint, sheen and joint sizes require
physical samples and product-specific verification before ordering.


The public edition omits the manufacturer swatch. The selected Saguaro product is named for reference only; the rendered floor uses CC0 oak grain.
